title: You Are My Father, And You
summary: Fear is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: You are my Father, and You are my Mother
lifeApplication: Read the line until fear is no longer the loudest narrator in the room. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
